title: Ticket 1.61.10 — تکمیل روند اسکن شبکه با آزمون یک مقصد (R28)
notes: R28 adds a non-persistent single-target credential/connectivity test, detects WinRM-only endpoints over TCP 5985 when ICMP is blocked, improves target-side WinRM diagnostics, and documents a secure one-account domain scan workflow. No database migration or production data change.
